name: VD800
tagline: Architectural wall-hung design featuring a three-sided panoramic fire view
description: The VD800 is a sophisticated, floating-style wood fireplace engineered for modern, minimalist interiors. Designed to be wall-mounted, it creates a striking visual statement while keeping floor spaces completely clear. It features a three-sided panoramic configuration with a large front viewing panel and matching side glass windows, offering an unobstructed, multi-angle view of the dancing flames from anywhere in the room.
features: Premium 152kg high-mass chassis engineered for secure wall-hung installation
Three-sided panoramic layout with matching side glass panels for wrap-around visibility
Ultra-wide front ceramic viewing window delivering maximum radiant warmth
Sleek floating profile that optimizes floor footprint and accentuates modern architecture
Seamless top flue outlet connection designed for clean, vertical chimney installations
